workflow_goal: Find a configurable number of top restaurant results for a Google Maps search query, return each restaurant URL, and send the suggestions to a specified WhatsApp contact as separate messages.

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: Google Maps search query for restaurants in a target area.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Exact WhatsApp contact name to open before sending the message.

inputs.name: result_limit
inputs.description: Number of top Google Maps restaurant results to extract and send. Defaults to 5.

steps.title: Search Google Maps and extract top restaurant names and URLs
steps.goal: Open Google Maps directly in a browser tab, run the provided search query, extract the primary name and Google Maps URL for the first result_limit restaurant entries from the left-side results panel, then close the Maps search tab after extraction. Use DOM access where possible; if the panel structure is ambiguous, use constrained model judgment on the rendered page to identify the primary result names and URLs.
steps.success_criteria: A list of exactly result_limit restaurants is captured in display order from Google Maps search results, each with a name and URL, and sendable WhatsApp messages are prepared: one intro message followed by one message per place.

steps.title: Open WhatsApp chat and send restaurant list
steps.goal: Drive the native WhatsApp Mac app (bundle id net.whatsapp.WhatsApp), not WhatsApp Web. Launch/activate the app, search the chat list for the provided contact name, open the matching chat, send the intro message "suggested places to eat, do a thumbsup where we should meet", then send each restaurant place as its own separate WhatsApp message using the Return key. WhatsApp Web is not used because the user is not logged into it; the user is logged into the native Mac app.
steps.success_criteria: The chat for the requested contact is opened and the intro plus each prepared restaurant place message are successfully sent as separate messages in the native WhatsApp Mac app.
